jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
ABOUT LEAP

Leap is one of the fastest-growing benefits solutions and a category-defining pioneer in employer specialty pharmacy. We are reshaping how life-changing therapies are delivered and financed, ensuring patients get the treatment they need while employers finally get a fair deal.

Specialty drugs and infusions represent nearly 10% of all healthcare spend and are the fastest-growing cost category for employers. Leap tackles this challenge with a novel approach: eliminating hidden markups, expanding access to high-quality infusion providers, and bringing clarity and fairness to how therapies are priced and paid for.

We’re proud to partner with numerous Fortune 500 companies and leading TPAs. Each patient we serve creates immediate ROI: lower costs, improved access, and better care. Join us as we redefine what’s possible in specialty care.



About the Role
Leap Health is entering a defining phase of growth. As we move to double our team again in the next 12 months, the complexity of the business will increase exponentially. We are looking for a Chief of Staff to build the connective tissue that holds the organization together.

In this role, you will be an accelerator. Your primary mandate is to ensure information flows seamlessly across the organization so that leadership can make high-quality decisions quickly. You will own the rhythm of the business and tackle high-priority cross-functional projects that allow us to scale without stalling.



Key Responsibilities

 - Architect the "Rhythm of Business": You will own the cadence and preparation for our most critical operating meetings (Executive Team Weekly, Monthly all Hands, QBRs, Board Meetings). You ensure that every meeting has a clear agenda, the necessary data is prepped in advance, and that we leave with explicit decisions and owners.

 - Maximize Decision Velocity: You will prevent decision paralysis by ensuring the CEO and Leadership Team have the right context at the right time. You will synthesize complex information from across the company into clear options and recommendations, ensuring no critical decision stalls due to lack of clarity.

 - Lead Special Projects: You will act as the interim owner for high-priority initiatives that fall outside of existing departments (e.g., executing a new market entry analysis, leading a compliance overhaul, or operationalizing a new partnership).

 - Drive Strategic Accountability (OKRs): You will manage our goal-setting process. You are the "scorekeeper" who tracks progress against our objectives, holding leaders accountable to their commitments and flagging deviations early.



Qualifications

 - The "Integrator" Mindset: 5+ years of experience in BizOps, Strategy, or Consulting. You are skilled at connecting dots between disparate functions.

 - Synthesis Skills: You can read a 20-page document or sit in a chaotic hour-long debate and distill it down to a one-page summary of the core issues and necessary next steps.

 - Process, Not Bureaucracy: You know how to implement just enough process to create speed and clarity, without adding administrative bloat that slows us down.

 - Healthcare/Tech Context: You understand that in health-tech, "move fast" must be balanced with clinical rigor. You can navigate complex stakeholder environments.

 - Data-Driven: You are comfortable digging into the metrics. You don't just report the numbers; you understand what they mean for the business model.



At Leap, we’re building an outlier company with real impact — and that takes focus, energy, and commitment. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Leap is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We’re committed to building a team that reflects a diversity of perspectives, experiences, and identities.

jobs.title: Director of Clinical Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT LEAP

Leap is one of the fastest-growing benefits solutions and a category-defining pioneer in employer specialty pharmacy. We are reshaping how life-changing therapies are delivered and financed, ensuring patients get the treatment they need while employers finally get a fair deal.

Specialty drugs and infusions represent nearly 10% of all healthcare spend and are the fastest-growing cost category for employers. Leap tackles this challenge with a novel approach: eliminating hidden markups, expanding access to high-quality infusion providers, and bringing clarity and fairness to how therapies are priced and paid for.

We’re proud to partner with numerous Fortune 500 companies and leading TPAs. Each patient we serve creates immediate ROI: lower costs, improved access, and better care. Join us as we redefine what’s possible in specialty care.



About the Role
Leap Health's Clinical Operations function — spanning Intake Operations, Care Operations, and Care Guide — is scaling 3x by year-end, and this role exists to give that growth a strategic engine, not just operational coverage. The Director of Clinical Strategy & Operations owns the company's highest-value cross-functional initiatives end to end: large client launches, condition-specific experimentation, and high-value activation experiments. This person operates as the project lead and charter owner for that work — designing the experiment, defining success metrics and owners, and driving it across Clinical Operations and stakeholders including Client Success, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and Engineering. Where the Strategy & Operations Manager executes and refines the existing playbook, this person builds the next one. Reporting to the Head of Member Operations and Strategy, this role extends that function's ability to take on efforts that no single team owns. Based in New York City. Hybrid, with at least 2 days per week in office, and travel to markets as needed.



Key Responsibilities

Company-Wide Experimentation & Initiative Leadership

 - Own the charter and execution of Leap's highest-value cross-functional efforts — large client launches, condition-specific experimentation, activation experimentation — acting as the project lead from design through results

 - Design structured experiments: define hypotheses, success metrics, timelines, and owners before work begins, and turn results into decisions leadership acts on

 - Drive alignment across Client Success, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and Engineering to keep company-wide initiatives moving, unblocking stalls wherever they show up

Clinical Operations Partnership

 - Partner closely with the managers of Intake Operations, Care Operations, and Care Guide to make sure initiatives and experiments are executed as designed within their teams

 - Serve as an informal escalation point when execution isn't tracking, without formal reporting authority over those teams

 - Build the operating models and playbooks that the Strategy & Operations Manager and team managers run day to day

Strategic Partnership to Leadership

 - Act as a thought partner to the Head of Member Operations and Strategy on the direction of Clinical Operations

 - Take ambiguous, company-wide problems and turn them into structured plans with clear owners, metrics, and timelines

 - Represent Clinical Operations in company-wide strategic conversations
   
   

Qualifications

Required:

 - 6-8+ years of experience in Business Operations, Strategy, or Consulting, combined with meaningful hands-on operating experience at a startup

 - A track record of designing and running structured experiments and translating results into decisions

 - Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives without formal authority over every stakeholder involved

 - Comfortable owning ambiguous, company-wide problems end to end — from framing through execution to results

 - Operationally tech-savvy. You have built dashboards yourself (Looker, Omni, or similar) and are comfortable getting hands-on with tooling.

Preferred:

 - Experience scaling operations through a 3x+ growth period

 - Has managed people directly, or is looking to build toward it

 - Healthcare, benefits, or other regulated-industry experience





At Leap, we’re building an outlier company with real impact — and that takes focus, energy, and commitment. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Leap is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We’re committed to building a team that reflects a diversity of perspectives, experiences, and identities.

The Strategic Client Success Manager is responsible for delivering exceptional service and driving client satisfaction across an assigned portfolio of strategic relationships with employers, TPAs, Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), and benefits consultants, while ensuring operational excellence to support client retention, growth, and measurable value delivery. You’ll serve as the face of our amazing organization to clients, and advance our mission by promoting our services in a proactive, data-driven way. This position reports to the SVP of Client Operations & Success.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates ideally based in Central Time zone.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


1. STRATEGIC ACCOUNT OWNERSHIP

 - Own the end-to-end client lifecycle for assigned employer and partner accounts, including implementation support, adoption strategy, performance management, renewals, and long-term retention

 - Develop and execute account plans aligned to client healthcare and cost-containment strategies

 - Serve as the primary strategic advisor to HR, Benefits leaders, TPAs, and PBMs


2. VALUE DELIVERY & EXECUTIVE ENGAGEMENT

 - Lead quarterly and annual business reviews highlighting utilization trends, financial performance, savings impact, and member experience metrics

 - Clearly articulate Leap’s value proposition, translating performance data into actionable insights and executive-level recommendations

 - Demonstrate strong executive presence in data-driven discussions with senior stakeholders


3. GROWTH & EXPANSION

 - Identify and drive expansion opportunities in partnership with Growth and Growth Marketing teams
   Increase patient engagement and program utilization within existing accounts

4. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP & RISK MANAGEMENT

 - Partner cross-functionally with clinical, operations, product, and support teams to ensure seamless service delivery

 - Collect and synthesize client feedback to inform process and product improvements

 - Proactively identify account risks and execute mitigation strategies to protect retention
   
    


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5–7+ years of experience in healthcare, benefits consulting, population health, digital health, or employer-focused client success

 - Experience managing employer accounts and working directly with HR or Benefits leadership as well as TPAs

 - Proven track record of driving revenue retention and high client satisfaction

 - Strong executive presence with the ability to present performance data and insights effectively

 - Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment

 - Collaborative team player with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Preferred location: Central Time Zone

 - Willingness to travel up to 30%

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director of Client Success leads Leap's team of senior Strategic Client Success Managers and owns the systems that let us deliver a white glove experience to every client while the business grows at extreme velocity. You will manage and develop a team of experienced, principal-level client leaders who each own strategic relationships with employers, TPAs, Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), in partnership with the benefits consultants. You will also carry executive relationships with our most strategic clients and be the senior point of escalation for the team.

This is a builder role. Our client base is growing faster than our team, and the next stage requires operating rhythms, escalation paths, and account coverage models that scale without making any client feel like a number. This position reports to the SVP of Client Operations & Success.

Build The Operating System For Client Success

 - Design and run the team's operating rhythm, including a daily or weekly standup that surfaces risks, blockers, and wins quickly without adding busywork

 - Create a clear escalation process: what the team resolves on its own, what comes to you, and what goes to clinical, operations, product, or executive leadership, with defined response times

 - Build playbooks, account plans, health scoring, and renewal workflows that let each team member manage more clients without losing quality

 - Track and report on team and portfolio metrics, including retention, utilization, client satisfaction, and time to resolution

 - Develop a team that knows how to launch and upsell clients to the best benefit plan design that drives the highest engagement.

 - The leader will know how to overcome barriers and strong negotiating skills

Deliver White Glove Service At Scale

 - Make sure every client feels known and well served, even as volume and pace increase

 - Set service standards for responsiveness, communication, and follow through, and hold the team to them

 - Spot where process is breaking under growth and fix it before clients feel it

Own Executive Client Relationships

 - Serve as the executive sponsor and senior escalation point for our most strategic employer, TPA, PBM, and consultant relationships

 - Lead or support quarterly and annual business reviews that translate utilization, savings, and member experience data into clear recommendations

 - Partner with Growth and Growth Marketing on renewals, expansion, finalist presentations, and client references

 - Partner with clinical, operations, product, and support leaders to ensure seamless service delivery

 - Bring structured client feedback into product and process decisions

 - Proactively identify portfolio-level risk and lead mitigation plans to protect retention

 - Experience working in start up environments or the pace of a start up

 - A relationship-first leader who builds trust quickly with HR and Benefits executives, with strong executive presence and the backbone to push back on clients when it is the right call

 - A track record of building team operating systems from scratch: standups, escalation paths, playbooks, coverage models, and metrics

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LEAP

Leap is one of the fastest-growing benefits solutions and a category-defining pioneer in employer specialty pharmacy. We are reshaping how life-changing therapies are delivered and financed, ensuring patients get the treatment they need while employers finally get a fair deal.

Specialty drugs and infusions represent nearly 10% of all healthcare spend and are the fastest-growing cost category for employers. Leap tackles this challenge with a novel approach: eliminating hidden markups, expanding access to high-quality infusion providers, and bringing clarity and fairness to how therapies are priced and paid for.

We’re proud to partner with numerous Fortune 500 companies and leading TPAs. Each patient we serve creates immediate ROI: lower costs, improved access, and better care. Join us as we redefine what’s possible in specialty care.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help build and scale the programs that turn eligible members into engaged, active Leap members. Reporting to the Head of Member Activation & Lifecycle Growth, you’ll play a key role in developing lifecycle strategy while owning the day-to-day execution and optimization of member communications across email, SMS, direct mail, landing pages, employer channels, and more.

You’ll work across the entire member journey, from initial awareness and enrollment through activation, treatment, ongoing engagement and retention, identifying the right message, channel, and moment to help members take the next step.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful ownership across both lifecycle strategy and execution. You’ll help shape how Leap engages members throughout their journey, translating insights and business priorities into thoughtful, multi-channel programs that drive action. You’ll own programs from strategy through launch and optimization, bringing together strong lifecycle strategies, operational excellence, experimentation, and a deep understanding of the member experience.

You’ll work closely with Client Success, Member Services, Clinical, Product, Data, Sales, and other teams to create a member experience that is clear, supportive, personalized, and measurable.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and optimize lifecycle journeys: Help design and continuously improve member journeys across awareness, enrollment, activation, treatment, and ongoing engagement. Define audiences, triggers, messaging, channel strategy, and success metrics for each stage.

 - Own multi-channel campaign execution: Build, launch, and optimize integrated campaigns across email, SMS, direct mail, landing pages, and employer-owned channels, including HR communications, benefits portals, open enrollment materials, and more.

 - Translate strategy into compelling member communications: Develop campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, and creative direction that turn complex healthcare information into communications that are simple, relevant, empathetic, and action-oriented. Write and edit member-facing copy directly when needed.

 - Lead lifecycle marketing for client launches: Partner with Client Success and Implementation to develop and execute member communication strategies for new client launches, including timelines, audience strategy, client-specific messaging, employer toolkits, approvals, deployment, and post-launch measurement.

 - Own lifecycle marketing operations: Manage campaign builds, segmentation, personalization, journey orchestration, QA, deployment, and ongoing optimization within our lifecycle marketing platform. Build scalable processes, templates, documentation, and campaign calendars that enable the team to move quickly without sacrificing quality.

 - Develop and optimize landing experiences: Lead the strategy, content, and optimization of member-facing landing pages, partnering with Design and Engineering where needed to improve conversion and create a seamless experience from communication to action.

 - Build a culture of experimentation: Execute a testing roadmap across subject lines, messaging, creative, calls to action, timing, cadence, channel mix, personalization, and journey structure. Design thoughtful A/B and multivariate tests, analyze results, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

 - Measure what drives member action: Define and track KPIs across the member lifecycle, including enrollment, activation, engagement, conversion, and retention. Partner with data to build reporting that connects campaign and channel performance to member outcomes and helps us understand what is driving results across both digital and offline touchpoints.

 - Continuously improve the member experience: Partner closely with Member Services, Clinical, and Client Success to understand member questions, barriers, and behaviors. Use those insights to improve messaging, journeys, and the overall experience across every member touchpoint.

 - Ensure compliant, high-quality communications: Maintain rigorous standards for accuracy, QA, privacy, and consent. Ensure member communications align with HIPAA, TCPA, CAN-SPAM, and internal compliance requirements in partnership with Legal and Compliance.

 - Be a trusted cross-functional partner: Serve as a lifecycle marketing partner across the organization, bringing a member-first perspective to launches, programs, and new initiatives while translating insights from campaign performance and member behavior into opportunities for improvement.

 - Manage external partners: Coordinate with print and direct mail vendors, agencies, and technology partners to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5–7+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, growth, member engagement, or a related discipline, with significant hands-on experience building and executing campaigns.

 - Deep hands-on experience with a lifecycle marketing platform such as Braze, Iterable, Customer.io http://Customer.io, or a similar platform, including journey orchestration, segmentation, personalization, testing, and campaign deployment.

 - Experience building integrated lifecycle programs across email and SMS, with experience in direct mail, landing pages, or other channels strongly preferred.

 - Strong lifecycle marketing instincts. You understand how to move members from awareness to action through thoughtful segmentation, messaging, timing, personalization, and channel strategy.

 - Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex or sensitive topics into communications that are clear, approachable, credible, and easy to act on.

 - Strong analytical skills and experience using campaign performance, behavioral data, and experimentation to identify opportunities and improve conversion.

 - Experience designing and evaluating A/B and multivariate tests, with the ability to distinguish meaningful insights from noise and translate findings into future strategy.

 - Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, client launches, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality, particularly when working with member-facing healthcare communications.

 - Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, CAN-SPAM, consent requirements, and other considerations related to healthcare and consumer communications.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment where processes are still being built and priorities can shift quickly.

 - A highly collaborative working style and the ability to influence and partner effectively across teams and seniority levels.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in healthcare, digital health, specialty pharmacy, benefits, or another B2B2C environment where end users are reached through employers, health plans, or other partners.

 - Experience developing employer-facing communication toolkits, benefits communications, or open enrollment campaigns that drive employee awareness and engagement.

 - Experience marketing healthcare services where members may be navigating complex
